messages:
sam-peopleops: Heads up — Devon's start is next Monday but the client moved them to a new worksite yesterday and asked us to issue an H-1B amendment. What immediate steps?

olga-immigration: We'll need an amended petition (H-1B LCA for the new worksite + H-1B amendment filing). Ask client for new address, SOC code, salary at new site, and onsite manager contact.

devon-newhire: I accepted the offer with Redwood and already signed onboarding forms. Does amendment block my first day?

lisa-legal: Amendment itself won't block the start if Devon already has valid H-1B at initial worksite, but if the new site is a material change we prefer to file amendment asap. For payroll/I-9 there's no change — keep using existing documents.

sam-peopleops: Ok — ask client to send a site confirmation email and onsite manager contact. We'll hold in onboarding until we have the LCA details. Devon, keep your travel local until we confirm.

olga-immigration: Also note LCA posting requirement: we need to post the LCA notice at the new site for 10 business days or provide electronic notice to employees per our policy. Please confirm whether on-site posting is possible or client needs us to post electronically.

devon-newhire: Client said on-site posting is fine and manager can sign. I'll send the manager's contact now.

payroll-bot: Reminder: amendment filings can affect payroll billing codes. Sam, please mark the employee record as "pending amendment" so billing isn't switched mid-cycle.

lisa-legal: We'll prepare LCA and amendment draft. Once client confirms salary and address we can file the LCA (7 business day ETA) and then submit amendment. We'll post the LCA notice template here for the client to sign.

sam-peopleops: Thanks. Devon, upload the signed site confirmation and manager contact to the HR portal. We'll coordinate with legal and immigration to keep your start intact.

olga-immigration: Filing plan: LCA -> 10-day notice -> submit amendment. We'll aim to file this week. If anything changes we'll update the thread. :checkered_flag:
